findings.title: Missing Input Validation Patterns
findings.description: No input validation constraints (minLength, maxLength, pattern, @Valid) found in API definitions.
findings.remediation: Add validation constraints to all request parameters: minLength, maxLength, pattern, minimum, maximum in OpenAPI spec or @Valid annotations in code.
findings.owasp_ref: API3:2023 - Broken Object Property Level Authorization

findings.title: No Rate Limiting Configuration
findings.description: No rate limiting mechanism detected. APIs without rate limiting are vulnerable to abuse and denial of service.
findings.remediation: Implement rate limiting using Bucket4j (Java), express-rate-limit (Node.js), or API Gateway throttling. Configure per-user and per-IP limits.

findings.title: Missing API Versioning Strategy
findings.description: No API versioning pattern detected (/v1/, /v2/, version headers). Versioning enables safe deprecation of insecure endpoints.
findings.remediation: Implement URL-based versioning (/api/v1/) or header-based versioning (Accept: application/vnd.api.v1+json).

findings.title: Missing OAuth2/JWT Configuration
findings.description: No OAuth2 or JWT authentication configuration found. APIs must authenticate requests.
findings.remediation: Configure Spring Security OAuth2 Resource Server or implement JWT validation middleware.

findings.title: Missing Authorization Controls
findings.description: No authorization annotations or middleware found. Endpoints may be accessible without proper access control.
findings.remediation: Add @PreAuthorize, @Secured, or @RolesAllowed annotations (Java) or auth middleware (Node.js) to all endpoints.

findings.title: Missing Input Validation
findings.description: No input validation annotations or middleware detected. User input must be validated before processing.
findings.remediation: Add @Valid, @Pattern, @Size annotations (Java) or Joi/Zod validation schemas (Node.js) to all request handlers.
findings.owasp_ref: API3:2023 - Broken Object Property Level Authorization

findings.title: Missing CORS Configuration
findings.description: No CORS configuration found. Without explicit CORS policy, browsers may block legitimate requests or allow unauthorized origins.
findings.remediation: Configure explicit CORS origins (never use '*' in production). Set allowed methods, headers, and credentials policy.

findings.title: Missing Global Error Handler
findings.description: No global exception handler found. Unhandled errors may leak stack traces and internal details to clients.
findings.remediation: Implement @ControllerAdvice (Java) or global error middleware (Node.js) that returns sanitized error responses.

findings.title: Missing Security Logging
findings.description: No security event logging configuration found. Security events must be logged for audit and incident response.
findings.remediation: Configure structured logging for authentication events, authorization failures, and input validation errors.
